pp.loadedSoFar: People loaded so far: {n}. The numbers show when the whole list is here.
pp.noTeacherBody: They will have no teacher until you set one. Their class and their learning stay as they are.
pp.removeBody: They are signed out on every device and lose their class and teacher. Their learning record stays with them.
pp.suspendBody: They are signed out and can't sign in until you restore them. Only logins the organization made can be suspended: someone with their own email or Google sign-in is listed as not done, and can be removed instead.
pp.resetBody: Their current passwords stop working at once. Each gets a new one and chooses their own at the next sign-in. The new passwords are shown only once, here: download or print them before you leave this page.
pp.progress: Working: {done} of {total} done. Keep this page open.
pp.refusedN: Not done: {n}. They are still selected, with the reason for each below.
pp.stopped: This stopped after {done} of {total}. The rest are still selected: try them again.
pp.slipsHint: Give each person their new password privately.
pp.slipsDone: I have saved them: back to the list
pp.inviteLimit: Adding more than about {n} people? Import them from a spreadsheet instead: sign-ups from one network, like a school's Wi-Fi, are limited each hour.
pp.copyManual: It couldn't be copied for you. It is selected below: copy it yourself.
pp.resetOneBody: The current password stops working at once. The new one is shown here once, for you to pass on privately.
pp.roleBody: They are signed out and sign in again with the new role. A student who becomes a teacher or an admin loses their own teacher; a teacher who becomes a student leaves their students without one.
pp.suspendOneBody: They are signed out and can't sign in until you restore the account. Nothing of their learning is deleted.
pp.suspendOwnLogin: This person signs in with their own email or Google account, so the organization can't suspend it. Remove them from the organization instead.
pp.staffFailed: The list of teachers couldn't be loaded, so a teacher can't be chosen yet.
pp.sso.title: School sign-in
pp.sso.onlyHint: The school's own sign-in opens this account, so it has no Darsi password to reset. A login that doesn't work is mended at the school. It can be disconnected only after the person adds an email login (Me, then “School sign-in”).
pp.sso.madeHint: The person has since added a login of their own (email or Google), so the school's sign-in isn't the only way into this account.
pp.sso.checking: Checking the school's sign-in for this person…
pp.sso.st.active: The school's sign-in opens this account.
pp.sso.st.blockedAdmin: School sign-in is blocked for this person: an admin blocked it.
pp.sso.st.blockedSuspension: School sign-in is blocked because the account is suspended. It works again when the account is restored.
pp.sso.st.removed: The organization removed this person, so the school's sign-in keeps them out. “Let back in” opens it again.
pp.sso.st.none: No school sign-in is connected to this account now.
pp.sso.how.jit: The school's sign-in made this account.
pp.sso.how.org-made: An account the organization made, matched to the person's school account at their first school sign-in.
pp.sso.how.self: The person connected their own account from Me.
pp.sso.how.admin-map: An admin connected this account to the school's sign-in.
pp.sso.linked: Connected to the school's sign-in since {date}.
pp.sso.gone: This person isn't in the organization now.
pp.sso.blockBody: The school's sign-in stops opening this account until you unblock it. Someone with no other way in is signed out everywhere. A login of their own (email or Google) still works.
pp.sso.unblockBody: The school's sign-in opens this account again. A block that came with a suspension is lifted by restoring the account instead.
pp.sso.unlinkBody: The school's sign-in no longer opens this account: the person signs in with their own login, and can connect again from Me. An account with no other way in can't be disconnected.
pp.sso.allowBackBody: For someone the organization removed. An account the school's sign-in made, or a username account the organization manages, goes back into the organization as a student. A person's own account is not put back: the school's sign-in is allowed for them again, and they join with an invite code.
pp.sso.blockedAlready: School sign-in was already blocked for {name}.
pp.sso.unblockedNone: Nothing was unblocked: no admin had blocked {name}'s school sign-in. If the account is suspended, restore it instead.
pp.sso.unlinkedNone: Nothing was disconnected: {name} had no working connection.
pp.sso.back: {name} is back in the organization as a student, and the school's sign-in opens the account again.
pp.sso.backIn: The school's sign-in opens {name}'s account again.
pp.sso.backOwn: {name} may come back. Nothing was put back into the organization: a person's own account stays theirs (they join again with an invite code), and a deleted one is made anew at their next school sign-in.
pp.sso.rf.only: This account opens only through the school's sign-in, so disconnecting it would lock the person out. They add an email login first (Me, then “School sign-in”); after that it can be disconnected.
pp.sso.rf.blocked: School sign-in is blocked for this person. Unblock it first, then disconnect.
pp.sso.rf.notRemoved: This person wasn't removed from school sign-in here, so there is nothing to let back in.
pp.sso.rf.none: This person has no school sign-in in this organization any more. Reload the page.
pp.sso.rf.otherOrg: This person belongs to another organization now, so they can't be let back in here.
pp.sso.rf.staff: This person is a platform admin, and platform admins never use a school's sign-in.
pp.sso.rf.orgInactive: This organization isn't active, so nobody can be let back in.
